task_completion.description: Agent opens the Jitsi Meet configuration file (config.js or custom-config.js) for editing.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing the contents of /home/ga/.jitsi-meet-cfg/web/config.js or custom-config.js.

task_completion.description: Agent sets the googleAnalyticsTrackingId to 'UA-88224411-1' in the configuration file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The line 'googleAnalyticsTrackingId: "UA-88224411-1"' (or similar syntax) visible in the editor or via a 'cat' command.

task_completion.description: Agent ensures the analytics script 'libs/analytics-ga.min.js' is referenced or enabled in the config.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The configuration file showing the analytics handler or script path 'libs/analytics-ga.min.js'.

task_completion.description: Agent verifies the configuration is active, typically by checking the browser console or network tab of the Jitsi instance.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A browser window showing the Jitsi Meet interface with the Developer Tools open, specifically showing the Tracking ID in the DOM, console logs, or a network request to google-analytics.com.

task_completion.description: Agent saves a screenshot of the verification to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command showing 'screenshot' or 'save' to '~/analytics_verification.png' or a file explorer showing the file exists in the home directory.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual configuration files and browser, rather than just creating a dummy image.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show a sequence of file editing followed by browser verification, not just the final image creation.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo 'success' or create an empty file named analytics_verification.png.
integrity.visual_evidence: The content of the verification screenshot (if viewed) or the process shows the actual Jitsi interface and config values.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific Tracking ID provided in the task, not a placeholder.
integrity.visual_evidence: The string 'UA-88224411-1' is visible in the configuration and verification steps.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Jitsi Meet configuration is located at /home/ga/.jitsi-meet-cfg/web/config.js or custom-config.js. To enable Google Analytics, the 'googleAnalyticsTrackingId' must be set to 'UA-88224411-1'. The standard analytics script used by Jitsi is 'libs/analytics-ga.min.js'. Verification is successful if the Jitsi web interface loads this ID, which can be seen in the browser's page source or network traffic to Google Analytics.
